indices.name: S&P 500
indices.note: Lost about 31 points but still logged its first weekly gain since early October.

indices.name: Nasdaq
indices.note: Dropped about 230 points as chip stocks sold off again.

indices.name: Dow
indices.note: Edged up about 50 points as money rotated out of tech.

notes: Chipmakers led the decline a day after Jensen Huang's exit as Nvidia CEO: Nvidia slipped 2% to about $163 (roughly 12% lower for the week), AMD fell about 8–9%, and Broadcom, Intel and Micron each lost around 5–6%.

October producer prices rose 0.3% on the month, a bit below forecasts, but the 6.5% yearly rise was the biggest since late 2022; the 10-year Treasury yield touched about 5.17% and traders still expect a Fed hike in December.
Tech was the weakest sector while consumer staples and communication services gained; oil was roughly flat near $89, and Bitcoin fell below $70,000 for the first time in about three months.
events: Tue 17 Nov, after the US close (overnight into Wed, Kuwait time): Nvidia reports quarterly results.
Thu 19 Nov: Anthropic's IPO is expected to start trading on Nasdaq, with pricing due the day before.
Wed 9 Dec, 22:00 Kuwait time: Federal Reserve rate decision; markets are pricing in a hike.
